svg.font-family: Inter, Helvetica, Arial, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif
svg.text: ISOLATED — the passthrough nets connect to no board net. Not the ground plane, not a rail. No indicator LED: the voltage is unknown.
7-port USB 2.0 HS · strap mode · port 3 n/c
UART level shift · VREF from target
SPDT signal relay · gold contacts · 1 A
GND CTS VCC TXD RXD DTR · 3.3 V
V+ via NO · GND via bus
GND · copper bus ≥ 5 mm, both outer layers
Mechanical — 140 × 100 mm · 4× M3, 7 mm from each corner · to scale · component side
front edge — overflow from the short edges; your end on the left, the target's on the right · back edge: the RJ45
Indicators — on the net, not on a pin
Switched outputs, green — PORT 1–4, FT231X, +5V_TGT at the eFuse (6)
TX / RX — FT231X CBUS, beside J9 (2)
None on J18 / J19 — the voltage is whatever was plugged in
An LED shows the actual state: a switch tripped on overcurrent goes dark even if firmware thinks it is on.
